"""Join paired timing, identity, gradient and process-guard evidence."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np

cases = {}
for policy in ('off', 'on'):
    name = 'onnax-shared-formal-' + policy
    record = json.loads(Path('/tmp/' + name + '.json').read_text())
    guard = json.loads(Path('/tmp/' + name + '-guard/execution.json').read_text())
    assert record['status'] == 'complete' and len(record['samples']) == 100
    assert record['warmup_steps'] == 10
    assert guard['status'] == 'complete' and guard['returncode'] == 0
    assert record['parameters_unchanged']
    assert record['ort']['cpu_fallback_disabled']
    assert record['ort']['graph_optimization'].endswith('ORT_DISABLE_ALL')
    assert record['environment']['ONNXRUNTIME_EP_MLX_NO_COMPILE'] == '1'
    assert record['environment']['ONNXRUNTIME_EP_MLX_CACHE_LIMIT_BYTES'] == '536870912'
    assert record['environment']['ONNXRUNTIME_EP_MLX_NO_GATED_DELTA_REVERSE'] == '0'
    assert record['environment']['ONNXRUNTIME_EP_MLX_NO_SHARED_INITIALIZERS'] == ('1' if policy == 'off' else '0')
    record['guard'] = {k: v for k, v in guard.items() if k != 'observations'}
    record['guard']['peak_physical_bytes'] = max(row['peak_bytes'] for row in guard['observations'])
    cases[policy] = record
for key in ('library_sha256', 'benchmark_source_sha256', 'input_sha256', 'adapter_sha256',
            'source_identity', 'input_shape', 'prediction_targets_per_step',
            'native_source', 'onnax_source', 'versions', 'torch_threads', 'ort'):
    assert cases['off'][key] == cases['on'][key], key
with (np.load('/tmp/onnax-shared-formal-off.npz', allow_pickle=False) as first,
      np.load('/tmp/onnax-shared-formal-on.npz', allow_pickle=False) as second):
    assert set(first.files) == set(second.files) and len(first.files) == 60
    gradients = {}
    for name in first.files:
        a, b = first[name], second[name]
        assert a.dtype == b.dtype and a.shape == b.shape
        assert np.isfinite(a).all() and np.isfinite(b).all()
        np.testing.assert_allclose(a, b, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-6)
        gradients[name] = {'shape': list(a.shape), 'dtype': str(a.dtype),
                           'max_abs': float(np.max(np.abs(a-b))),
                           'byte_identical': a.tobytes() == b.tobytes(),
                           'off_sha256': hashlib.sha256(a.tobytes()).hexdigest(),
                           'on_sha256': hashlib.sha256(b.tobytes()).hexdigest()}
losses = {key: np.array([row['loss'] for row in record['samples']], np.float32)
          for key, record in cases.items()}
np.testing.assert_allclose(losses['off'], losses['on'], rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-6)
report = {'version': 1, 'cases': cases, 'gradients': gradients,
          'all60_gradients_byte_identical': all(row['byte_identical'] for row in gradients.values()),
          'all100_losses_byte_identical': losses['off'].tobytes() == losses['on'].tobytes(),
          'driver_source': Path('/tmp/onnax-shared-formal-driver.py').read_text(),
          'verifier_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
          'median_ratio_off_over_on': cases['off']['summary']['gradient_step_seconds']['median'] / cases['on']['summary']['gradient_step_seconds']['median'],
          'scope': 'Fixed trained parameters; full task forward, shifted-token mean loss and all60adapter gradients; 10warmups100samples per fresh process; optimizer excluded'}
Path('/tmp/onnax-shared-formal-qualified.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({key: {'summary': case['summary']['gradient_step_seconds'],
                       'initial_step_seconds': case['initial_step_seconds'],
                       'construction_seconds': case['bundle_load_and_sessions_seconds'],
                       'guard_peak_physical_GiB': case['guard']['peak_physical_bytes']/2**30}
                  for key, case in cases.items()}))
print('All60gradients byte identical:', report['all60_gradients_byte_identical'])
scope: Fixed trained parameters; full task forward, shifted-token mean loss and all60adapter gradients; 10warmups100samples per fresh process; optimizer excluded
